wargear.name: Ember-banner
wargear.text: Each Model in a Unit that includes a Model equipped with an Ember-banner adds 1 to its Willpower Characteristic and 1 to its Intelligence Characteristic.
wargear.summary: A banner woven on Nocturne from the cloth of a hearth the Legion swore to defend.

wargear.name: Forge-blessed bandolier
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Forge-blessed bandolier has the Fuel Reserve Special Rule.
wargear.summary: Fuel canisters slung across the chest, filled to the cap.

wargear.name: Mantle of the Drake
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Mantle of the Drake adds 1 to its Toughness Characteristic and has the Drake-Hide Mantle Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A cloak of dragon-hide cured on Nocturne's slopes.

wargear.name: Interlocked pavises
wargear.text: Each Model in a Unit that includes a Model equipped with Interlocked pavises has the Pavise Wall Special Rule.
wargear.summary: Heavy shields that lock edge to edge.

wargear.name: Salvage-crew toolkit
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Salvage-crew toolkit has the Field Mending Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A crew that carries a forge on its back.

wargear.name: Hearth-ram dozer blade
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Hearth-ram dozer blade has the Hearth-ram Plough Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A broad blade of Nocturnean steel.

wargear.name: Hearthfire standard
wargear.text: Each Model in a Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Hearthfire standard has the Hearthfire Anchor Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A banner-pole with a steady lamp at its crown.

wargear.name: Wyrmscale vambrace
wargear.summary: A forearm guard of drake-hide, quenched in the forge until it will not scorch.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Wyrmscale vambrace has the Hearth-Warded Special Rule.

wargear.name: Lamp of the Long Road
wargear.summary: A hooded lantern that has lit a hundred refugee camps.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Lamp of the Long Road has the Light in the Dark Special Rule.

modifiers.text: Shield-bearers of the weak: +1 LD, -1 A.
Mantle of the Drake: +1 T, Drake-Hide Mantle.
Wrath of the Drake: +1 A, -1 I.

rites.name: Forge-Fires of Nocturne
rites.flavor: The drakes walk in front, and nothing that burns stays standing.
benefits: Pyroclast and Firedrake Terminator Squads may fill Troops slots.
Pyroclast and Firedrake squads gain Forge-Fire: Shooting Attacks made with their flame (Template) weapons add 1 to their Wound Tests.
limitations: At least one Pyroclast or Firedrake squad is required.
No Fast Attack or Recon units, and nothing with the Antigrav type.

require.note: Bring a Pyroclast or Firedrake squad.

rites.name: Shield of the Weak
rites.flavor: Vulkan taught his sons that a wall is only a wall when someone stands behind it.
benefits: Sanctifier Squads may fill Troops slots.
Adherents and Sanctifier Squads gain Line (1) and Shield Wall: they automatically pass Leadership Checks and Cool Checks while they have not moved this turn.
limitations: At least one Adherents Squad and one Sanctifier Squad are required.
No Fast Attack, Recon or Lord of War units.

modifiers.text: Shield of the Weak: Line (1), Shield Wall.

rites.name: The Armoured Anvil
rites.flavor: On Nocturne even the tanks are tempered twice.
benefits: Armour and Transport vehicles (other than Flyers) gain +1 Hull Point.
Armour units gain Anvil Advance: Line (1), and they may make Shooting Attacks after Rushing in the first battle turn.
limitations: At least two Armour units are required, and no more than three Infantry units in Troops slots.
No Drop Pods, Dreadclaws or Kharybdis, and nothing with the Antigrav type.

modifiers.text: The Armoured Anvil: Line (1), Anvil Advance.

require.note: The Anvil needs at least two Armour units.

limit.note: At most three Infantry units in Troops slots.

rites.name: Procession of the Honoured
rites.flavor: The entombed brothers are carried to war so that none of them is ever left behind.
benefits: Contemptor and Castra Ferrum Dreadnoughts may fill Troops slots.
They gain Line (1) and Unbowed Elders: once per battle each may treat one Hit Test as a roll of 6.
limitations: At least two Dreadnoughts are required.
No Terminator squads, and no Heavy Assault units.

modifiers.text: Procession of the Honoured: Line (1), Unbowed Elders.

require.note: At least two Dreadnoughts march in the procession.

rules.name: Forge-Fire
rules.text: A Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to the Wound Tests of its Shooting Attacks made with Weapons that have the Template Special Rule.
rules.summary: The drakes walk in front, and nothing that burns stays standing.

rules.name: Shield Wall
rules.text: A Unit made up entirely of Models with this Special Rule that did not move in its Controlling Player's most recent Movement Phase automatically passes any Leadership Check or Cool Check it is required to make.
rules.summary: A wall is only a wall when someone stands behind it.

rules.name: Anvil Advance
rules.text: During the first Battle Turn, a Model with this Special Rule that Rushes may still make a Shooting Attack.
rules.summary: The tanks of Nocturne are tempered twice and they do not wait for the infantry.

rules.name: Unbowed Elders
rules.text: Once per Battle, a Model with this Special Rule may treat one Hit Test it makes as if the result of the Dice roll had been a 6.
rules.summary: The entombed brothers have never missed what they were aiming at.

rules.name: Fuel Reserve
rules.text: The first time in each Battle that a Unit including a Model with this Special Rule would suffer from a natural 1 for the Overstoked Promethium Special Rule, it ignores that result. In addition, the Unit adds 1 to the Wound Tests of its Shooting Attacks made with Weapons that have the Template Special Rule against enemy Units that are aflame.
rules.summary: Canisters filled to the cap burn hotter and last longer.

rules.name: Drake-Hide Mantle
rules.text: When a Model with this Special Rule suffers Damage from a Weapon that has the Template Special Rule or the Aflame (X) Special Rule, reduce that Damage by 1, to a minimum of 1.
rules.summary: Dragon-hide turns the worst of the fire aside.

rules.name: Pavise Wall
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule has the Shrouded (5+) Special Rule against Shooting Attacks, provided its Unit did not move in its Controlling Player's most recent Movement Phase.
rules.summary: Shields locked edge to edge turn the enemy's fire.

rules.name: Field Mending
rules.text: Once per Battle, at the start of its Controlling Player's Battle Turn, a Vehicle with this Special Rule may remove one Tactical Status from itself or restore one lost Hull Point.
rules.summary: A crew that carries a forge on its back keeps the engine fighting.

rules.name: Hearth-ram Plough
rules.text: A Vehicle with this Special Rule ignores movement penalties from barricades and rubble, and adds 1 to the number of Hits it inflicts when it moves through an enemy Unit.
rules.summary: A broad blade clears the way and the enemy with it.

rules.name: Hearthfire Anchor
rules.text: When a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule is counted for Controlling an Objective, it counts as having two additional Models for the purposes of determining Tactical Strength, and its Models add 1 to their Cool Characteristic while it does.
rules.summary: A steady lamp at its crown shows the line where to stand.

rules.name: Wrath of the Drake
rules.summary: Slow to anger, he is slower still to stop, and his sons would rather not see it.
rules.text: This Model adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic. When this Model's Unit destroys an enemy Unit in Combat, every enemy Unit within 6" of this Model must make a Cool Check; a Unit that fails gains the Pinned Tactical Status. This Model subtracts 1 from its Initiative Characteristic, and friendly Salamanders Units within 6" of it subtract 1 from their Cool Characteristic.

rules.name: Hand upon the Anvil
rules.summary: The Forge-Father at his work: what he touches burns hotter.
rules.text: Weapons with the Template or Melta Special Rule fired by friendly Salamanders Units within 6" of this Model add 1 to their Ranged Strength. This Model subtracts 1 from its Movement Characteristic.

rules.name: Shepherd of Hearths
rules.summary: He walks the line with a lamp, and gives away his own fire to keep it lit.
rules.text: At the start of each of its Controlling Player's Battle Turns, the Controlling Player may remove one Tactical Status from this Model or from one friendly Salamanders Unit within 6". This Model subtracts 1 from its Attacks Characteristic.

rules.name: Hearth-Warded
rules.summary: Fire is his oldest friend, and does not bite him.
rules.text: Saving Throws made by a Model with this Special Rule against Wounds inflicted by weapons with the Flame or Melta Trait are made with a +1 modifier.

rules.name: Light in the Dark
rules.summary: No one near it is alone in the dark.
rules.text: Friendly Salamanders Units within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule ignore the effects of the Pinned Tactical Status.

armyRules.name: Stoic Defenders
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Cool Characteristic if its Unit did not move in its Controlling Player's most recent Movement Phase.
drawbacks: A Unit with this Special Rule may not Rush during the first Battle Turn.
armyRules.condition: if the unit did not move in its last Movement phase

armyRules.name: Nocturne's Mercy
armyRules.flavor: A captain who tends his own.
benefits: Once per Battle, a Model with this Special Rule may restore one lost Wound to a friendly Infantry Model within 6".
drawbacks: A Model with this Special Rule may not Rush.

armyRules.name: Overstoked Promethium
benefits: Weapons with the Template Special Rule fired by a Unit with this Special Rule add 1 to the value of their Panic (X) Special Rule.
drawbacks: When a Hit Test made for such a Weapon has a natural result of 1, the firing Unit suffers 1 Hit from that Weapon.

armyRules.name: Walls Around the Hearth
armyRules.flavor: Where Vulkan stands, none of his sons will be seen to leave.
benefits: While Vulkan is on the battlefield, when Combat Resolution Points are totalled for a Combat, the Salamanders side adds 1 to its total for each friendly Salamanders Unit in that Combat within 12" of Vulkan, to a maximum of +3.
drawbacks: A friendly Salamanders Unit within 12" of Vulkan cannot voluntarily Fall Back.
If Vulkan is removed as a casualty, every friendly Salamanders Unit that was within 12" of him gains the Pinned Tactical Status.
